comments.author: ThatOneGuy
comments.body: This is made through the R14 sewing recipe listed above at Company Colonies with a Craftsman, but the required ingredients are Natal Indigo x12, Native Clothes x48, and Embroidery Thread x60.

comments.author: Visitor
comments.body: The cost of materials, and the sewing rank, are only raised if you produce this at a Company Colony. The listed materials and sewing rank are correct for production at the Great Plains shopkeeper's table of recipes.

comments.author: ThatOneGuy
comments.body: Eh, okay? But I think you can make different colored outfits in Company Colonies than at the Great Plains, which might explain why there's a different set of requirements. Well, I haven't unlocked GP yet, but that's what I heard.
